encoding.c: range bar = 10-90% over non-diverged runs, mark = median (N = inf), rule colour; INK triangle-down = median and INK line = 10-90% over runs of the per-run prediction (part 1: cond f(spec C0); part 3: weight decay from each run's sample eigenvalues, tied = 1), drawn just above the measured bar; rows in the order of the key strip, named by colour and marker only (critic r1: the r0 row labels part 1 / part 3 are recorded as panel_c.<rule>.theorem_part: part 1 for GD step 0.002 and small init., part 3 for weight decay and tied weights); no reference line at cond = 1 (critic r1); no outside row and no in-panel key in v8 (the caption decodes the marks); x log 0.93 to 8.6
encoding.d_e: one dot per pair of runs (alpha 0.6, 4.0 pt^2), vertical jitter +-0.27 row (seed 20261010, the same in d and e); vertical bar = mean on a white underlay; dashed line = 0; shared x [-1.6, 10.3] in SD of Delta_Gs(y) over the cell's pairs; tick labels = rule of the head; initialization named inside (e) in the group colour
